items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: He could sing good, play guitar good. And he kept a little outfit like that with him all the time. Tub, washboard, and a pipe, pipe horn.

ctx.x: Who would be some of those guys?

Well there was one guy that I called Sing and Shine. Sing and Shine. He could sing good, play guitar good. And he kept a little outfit like that with him all the time. Tub, washboard, and a pipe, pipe horn. You know, pipe horn.
